5687.title: [M156] Integrate Ganesh rendering and Graphite clip fixes
5687.body:
[M156] Integrate Ganesh rendering and Graphite clip fixes (#5687)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/444
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5698
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/d1717dc22ef2203b7fc9bf0e01078b37b1a4af6b...cb6f6ce6bf3aa7102bbffa49e4b760d948d68918

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to the
actual mono/skia merge cb6f6ce6bf3aa7102bbffa49e4b760d948d68918. Record
upstream 24e65cdd9b6421351dde22acd81dc604bd8073b8 on chrome/m156 while
retaining milestone 156 and the servicing line's version identities.

The merged native tree equals reviewed head
8c8de9aa05950b0b251924873c361a5441997b54. The dependent repin changes
commit identity and provenance, not the native source that was reviewed.
C API declarations and DEPS are unchanged; independent regeneration
found no binding differences. No managed API or release version changes.

~~ Avoid stale atlas work after empty Ganesh flushes ~~

Empty flushes could leave per-flush token comparisons stale. Advance
the draw token when GrOpFlushState resets and catch the flush token up,
so work scheduled during one flush is not treated as pending later.

~~ Correct transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry ~~

Fix the matrix-axis mapping of rrect radii and ellipse/rrect stroke
widths, and remove the redundant quarter-turn swap. Clamp transformed
corner radii to half the device-space bounds to prevent corner overlap.

~~ Keep Graphite clip draws within pass capacity ~~

Account for clip elements that still need recording without counting
already-recorded DrawListLayer clips twice. A fresh pass must fit the
draw and its full effective clip stack; warn and skip a draw that cannot
fit rather than exceeding render-step capacity.

The upstream DeviceTestClipRenderStepLimits regression exercises
accumulating and reused clip stacks, an oversized stack, and a normal
draw after restoring it, asserting that a recording can still be made.
